description: Co. Limerick Road Network (2010) is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Limerick City & County Council. The Road Schedule lists all roads that are in public use. It is a line dataset which is normally the centre line of the road. Other attribute data is also stored such as the average width, surface type. Coverage: Limerick City & County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Limerick City & County Council. Its tags are limerick, road, road network, traffic infrastructure, transport. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
